project.name: S3Drive
project.tagline: Your S3 bucket as a local Windows drive.
project.description: S3Drive mounts an Amazon S3 or S3-compatible bucket (Less3, Ceph, MinIO, and others) as a Windows drive letter. A system tray agent owns the mounts and keeps them up whether or not the terminal app is open.

artifacts.name: S3Drive
artifacts.summary: the terminal app for configuring and monitoring your drives

artifacts.name: S3Drive Agent
artifacts.summary: the system tray agent that mounts your buckets and keeps them mounted

prerequisites.name: Dokany
prerequisites.message: S3Drive mounts drives through the Dokany 2 file system driver, a separate free install from github.com/dokan-dev/dokany/releases.
